Label: EIC Awardee
Current description: Organisation formally selected, funded, or recognised by the European Innovation Council (EIC) through its programmes, prizes, or official selection processes
Proposed description: Organisation formally selected, funded, or recognised by the European Innovation Council (EIC) through its programmes, prizes, or official selection processes.

Label: EIC Organisation
Proposed description: An organisation created during an automatic import that is not (yet) recognised as an EIC Awardee. Promoted to EIC Awardee if and when it is confirmed as a funded/selected beneficiary.

Label: Investor
Proposed description: Investor organisation engaged with the EIC (e.g. through VentureMatch). Represented by one or more Investor Representative contacts.

Label: Investor Representative
Proposed description: A person representing an Investor organisation (linked via the 'Investor at' relationship).

Label: EIC Awardee representative
Current description: Contact officially listed in EIC Project database
Proposed description: Contact officially listed in the EIC Project database (coordinator, LEAR, participant contact, etc.), linked to an EIC Awardee organisation via an EIC role relationship.
